SELECT poi.product_name, poi.sku, SUM(poi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(poi.line_total) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS poi ON poi.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY poi.product_name, poi.sku ORDER BY poi.product_name, poi.sku LIMIT 100

WITH periods AS (SELECT DISTINCT reporting_period, period_start, period_end FROM sales_reports WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND period_end <= '2026-09-30' ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 6) SELECT p.reporting_period, p.period_start, p.period_end, SUM(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'revenue' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS confirmed_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN f.numeric_value END) AS confirmed_units, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM periods AS p JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.reporting_period = p.reporting_period AND sr.status = 'confirmed' JOIN report_facts AS f ON f.report_id = sr.id AND f.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY p.reporting_period, p.period_start, p.period_end ORDER BY p.period_end DESC
